rule: Every approved feedback event must show who benefits, what aggregate pattern was learned, which private memory stayed inside the tenant, and which payment route stayed blocked before network recommendations improve.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, or payment-custody signal can become a learning benefit or cross-organization recommendation in phase one.
benefit_principles: Turn real buyer, supplier, and founder outcomes into traceable feedback events.
Keep organization-private memory inside each tenant boundary.
Share only anonymized aggregate category, proof, response, and market-readiness patterns.
Show who benefits from the learned pattern before the recommendation changes.
Require human approval, reason, timestamp, and rollback state before network lift applies.
Measure benefit as safer recommendations, cleaner proof paths, and faster direct supplier response.
Block payment custody, rental value, deposits, payouts, escrow, and booking commissions from shared learning.

role_benefit_ledgers.network_benefit: next buyer sees a cleaner verified route

role_benefit_ledgers.aggregate_pattern: proof density and response reliability improved launch confidence
role_benefit_ledgers.network_benefit: next market gets safer country/category priority

acceptance: Marketplace shows the Learning Benefit Ledger after the Human Approval Replay Gate.
Buyer, supplier, and founder views each show contribution, private memory, aggregate pattern, network benefit, approval, rollback, and blocked payment route.
Copy output explains who benefits, what was learned, what stayed private, what was approved, and what payment route stayed blocked.
Build Phase shows the v169 Learning Benefit Ledger contract after the Human Approval Replay Gate contract.
Docs include benefit routes, private routes, blocked payment routes, and required benefit fields.
Static check fails if the benefit ledger UI, contract, JSON model, cache-bust token, or render functions are missing.
No payment-custody signal can become a shared learning benefit in phase one.
